name: Telecom BSS, Media & Publishing Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Telecommunications Business Support Systems (BSS), Media Streaming, and Publishing, covering SIM/subscriber provisioning, CDR usage rating, prepaid/postpaid billing, editorial workflows, digital rights management (DRM), and ad impression tracking.
owner: Global Telecom BSS & Media Publishing Operations Office

checklists.name: Telecom BSS & Media Publishing Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for subscriber provisioning, CDR rating, editorial publishing, and DRM rights management.

items.statement: Subscriber SIM card activation provisions voice/data services across HLR/HSS/5G Core network nodes.
Call Detail Records (CDR) rate voice minutes, SMS counts, and data megabytes accurately without double-charging.
Prepaid balance recharges update account balances instantaneously with electronic receipt delivery.
Editorial workflow requires editorial review and copy-editing approval prior to digital publication.
Digital Rights Management (DRM) servers verify user entitlements before issuing playback decryption keys.

reviewGates.name: Telecom & Media Operations Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Telecom BSS & Media Operations Director confirms that CDR rating accuracy, subscriber billing, and DRM controls satisfy industry standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the telecom & media documentation confirm rating accuracy and DRM protection?
